Rashi on Bava Metzia 16a:10:1.english: He gave it to him as a gift - The robbery victim [gave it] to the robber.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 16a:11:1.hebrew: ועד אימת - יקחנה מבעלים הראשונים, דאמרינן דמשום דניחא ליה דליקו בהימנותיה לקחה:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 16a:11:1.english: And until when - [If] he buys it from the original owners, [do] we say that he bought it because it is preferable for him to maintain his reliability?

Rashi on Bava Metzia 16a:11:2.hebrew: עד שעת העמדה בדין - עד שיטרפוה מן הלוקח ויעמידהו בדין. אבל משעמד ברשעו עד שעת העמדה בדין, גלי אדעתיה דלא מהימן הוא, ואם לקחה אחרי כן, לאו לאוקמיה קמיה לוקח בעי:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 16a:11:2.english: Until the time of standing trial - Until they seize it from the buyer and he brings him to trial. However, once he has persisted in his wickedness until the time of standing trial, he has shown that he is not trustworthy; and if he bought it afterward, he does not want to uphold it before the buyer.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 16a:12:1.hebrew: עד דמטא אדרכתא לידיה - עד שיחייבוהו ב"ד לפרוע ללוקח מעותיו, ועמד במרדו עד שכתבו פסק דין ונתנו ללוקח על נכסיו של גזלן, שבכ"מ שימצאם יחזיק בהן. והיינו תשעים יום לאחר שעמד בדין, כדאמרינן בהגוזל [בתרא] (ב"ק דף קיב:):
Rashi on Bava Metzia 16a:12:1.english: Until the authorization document reaches his hand - Until the court obligates him to repay the purchaser his money, and he persisted in his defiance until they wrote a verdict and gave [it] to the purchaser against the robber's property, that wherever he finds them he may seize them. And this is ninety days after he appeared in court, as we say in [the chapter] HaGozel [Batra] (Bava Kamma 112b).

Rashi on Bava Metzia 16a:12:2.hebrew: עד דמתחלן יומא דאכרזתא - לאחר שמצא זה קרקע משל גזלן ובא לב"ד, והן מכריזין שכל מי שרוצה לקנות קרקע יבא ויקחנה, כדאמרינן בערכין (דף כא:): שום היתומין שלשים יום:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 16a:12:2.english: Until the days of announcement begin - After this [purchaser] found land belonging to the robber and came to the court, and they announce that anyone who wants to buy land should come and acquire it, as we say in Arakhin (21b): "[The announcement for] the appraisal of orphans' [property] is thirty days."

Rashi on Bava Metzia 16a:13:1.english: Rami bar Hama objects to it - [He objects] to that [statement]: "What did the first [party] sell to the second, etc.?"

Rashi on Bava Metzia 16a:14:2.english: Where he trusts him - That he said to him: "I rely on you that you will place it in my hand."

Rashi on Bava Metzia 16a:14:3.english: He resolves and transfers [ownership] - When he purchases it from the original owners.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 16a:15:1.english: My net - Of beasts, birds, and fish.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 16a:15:2.hebrew: דבריו קיימין - לקמן פריך, מאי שנא רישא כו':
Rashi on Bava Metzia 16a:15:2.english: His statement stands - Later on, [the Gemara] asks: Why is the first clause different, etc.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 16a:16:1.hebrew: הא גברא והא תיובתא - הרי אדם גדול וכמוהו תשובתו, דקתני לא אמר כלום ולכשיירש לא קנה לוקח, כיון דההיא שעתא לאו דידיה הוו נכסי אביו, ולא אמרינן מה מכר לו ראשון לשני — כל זכות שתבא לידו:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 16a:16:1.english: This is the man and this is the refutation - Behold, [he is] a great man, and like him [is] his refutation, for it teaches: "he said nothing," and when he inherits, the buyer does not acquire [it], since at that time his father's property was not his, and we do not say: "What did the first sell to the second? Every right that will come into his hand."

Rashi on Bava Metzia 16a:17:1.hebrew: לא סמכא דעתיה - דלוקח, דקאמר: מי יימר שירש מאביו כלום? שמא ימכור אביו נכסיו בחייו:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 16a:17:1.english: He does not rely [on him] - [That is, the mind] of the purchaser, for he says: Who says that he will inherit anything from his father? Perhaps his father will sell his property during his lifetime.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 16a:18:1.english: They sent it - [namely,] this refutation of Rav Sheshet that he raised against Rav.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 16a:18:2.hebrew: אינה צריכה לפנים - אינה צריכה, כדי לתרצה, להכניסה לפני בני הישיבה, שאין בהן יודע לפרקה. ותשובת הגאונים פורשין לגנאי: דליכא קושיא מעליא, אל תעלוה לגיו:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 16a:18:2.english: It does not need [to be brought] inside - It does not need, in order to resolve it, to be brought inside before the members of the academy, for there is no one among them who knows how to refute it. And [in] the Responsa of the Geonim, they interpret [this] disparagingly: that there is no substantial difficulty [here], [so] do not bring it inside.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 16a:19:1.hebrew: הוה עובדא בפומבדיתא - שדנו דין כרב, ואותבינן מהא מתניתין, ואמר רב יוסף כו':
Rashi on Bava Metzia 16a:19:1.english: There was an incident in Pumbedita - That they judged a case in accordance with Rav, and we raised an objection from this Mishnah, and Rav Yosef said, etc.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 16a:1:1.hebrew: הא מית - לוקח, ומי יחרפנו עוד? הלכך לא נתכוון לזה אלא להעמידה בידו בחייו, ולא לאחר מותו. מ"ד כו':
Rashi on Bava Metzia 16a:1:1.english: Behold, he died - The purchaser [died], and who will revile him anymore? Therefore, he did not intend this except to maintain it in his [the purchaser's] possession during his lifetime, and not after his death. [And as for] the one who says, etc.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 16a:20:1.hebrew: משום כבוד אביו - כשהיה אביו גוסס וצריך מעות לקבורתו ולתכריכין, מוזהר לכבוד אביו שלא לשהותו בבזיון:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 16a:20:1.english: For the honor of his father - When his father was dying and he needed money for his burial and shrouds, [he] is admonished for the honor of his father not to leave him [unburied] in disgrace.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 16a:3:1.hebrew: דמית גזלן - לאחר שלקחה, והבנים באים להוציא מיד הלוקח:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 16a:3:1.english: Where [the] robber died - After he had bought it [from the original owner], and [his] sons come to extract [it] from the buyer's possession.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 16a:3:2.hebrew: הא מית ליה - ולא נתכוון להעמיד ממכרו אלא בימי חייו, שלא יחרפוהו:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 16a:3:2.english: He already died - And he only intended to uphold his sale during his lifetime, so that [people] would not disgrace him.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 16a:3:3.hebrew: אע"ג דמית ניחא ליה - מעיקרא:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 16a:3:3.english: Even though he died, it is preferable to him - [it was preferable to him] from the outset.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 16a:3:4.english: That he stand in his reliability - Even after death.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 16a:4:1.english: Ultimately, they call his children "children of a robber" - Thus, even after [his] death, they disgrace him.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 16a:6:1.hebrew: זבנה אורתה - אם קודם שלקח מן הבעלים, חזר ומכרה לאיש אחר לבד מן הראשון, או הורישה לאחד מבניו, או יהבה במתנה, ואחר כך לקחה — האי ודאי איגלי דעתיה דלאו לאוקמי קמיה לוקח ראשון בעי, ולא ניחא לי' דליקום בהימנותיה, שהרי מכרה לשני:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 16a:6:1.english: [If] he sold it, bequeathed it - If, before he bought [the land] from the [original] owners, he went back and sold it to another person besides the first [buyer], or bequeathed it to one of his sons, or gave it as a gift, and afterward bought it — in this [case], his intent is certainly revealed that he does not want to establish [it] before the first buyer, and he does not wish to uphold his good faith, for behold, he sold it to the second [person].

Rashi on Bava Metzia 16a:7:1.hebrew: נפלה ליה - לגזלן בירושה, שמתחילה גזלה לאחד ממורישיו ומת הנגזל:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 16a:7:1.english: It came to him - to the robber as an inheritance, for originally he stole it from one of those from whom he inherits, and the victim of the robbery died.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 16a:7:2.hebrew: ירושה ממילא הויא - והא ליכא למימר ניחא ליה דליקו בהימנותיה, דהא לא טרח אבתרה דנימא גלי דעתיה דניחא ליה דליקו. הלכך, הוי כיורש דעלמא וחוזר ותובעה, ונותן מעות ללוקח:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 16a:7:2.english: An inheritance is [acquired] passively - And [here] one cannot say [that] he wants to uphold his trustworthiness, since he did not make an effort [to acquire] it such that we would say he revealed his intent that he wants to uphold [his trustworthiness]. Therefore, he is like an ordinary heir and goes back and claims it, and gives [the] money [back] to the buyer.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 16a:8:1.hebrew: גבייה בחובו - לאחר שגזלה ומכר לו, ובא לו אצל נגזל ואמר לו: הגבה לי בחובי קרקע שגזלתיך:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 16a:8:1.english: He collected it for his debt - After he [the robber] stole it and sold [it] to him [the buyer], and came to the robbery victim and said to him: "Let me collect for my debt the land that I stole from you."

Rashi on Bava Metzia 16a:8:2.hebrew: אי אית ליה ארעא אחריתי - לנגזל שיכול לגבות חובו ממנה, ואמר ליה: בזו שגזלתי אני חפץ, הא טרח אבתרה, ואמרינן: לאוקמה קמיה לוקח בעי:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 16a:8:2.english: If he has other land - [Referring] to the robbery victim, from which [the robber] could collect his debt, and [instead the robber] said to him: "I want this [land] that I robbed" — behold, he went to trouble over it, and [therefore] we say [that] he wants to establish it before the buyer.

Tosafot on Bava Metzia 16a:10:1.hebrew: ארצי קמיה כי היכי דליקום בהימנותיה - משמע דהכי הלכתא, מדלא נקט לישנא דלא נקרייה גזלן; ועוד, דהלכה כרב אשי, דהוא בתראה וגדול בחכמה ובמנין:
Tosafot on Bava Metzia 16a:10:1.english: He ingratiated himself with him in order to maintain his reliability - This implies that the halakha is like this [opinion], since [the Gemara] did not use the wording "so that he should not be called a robber"; and furthermore, [it is] because the halakha is in accordance with Rav Ashi, as he is later and greater in wisdom and in number.

Tosafot on Bava Metzia 16a:13:1.hebrew: האי שטרא חספא בעלמא הוא - וא"ת: ולימא דקני לה במה שהחזיק בה אחר שקנאה גזלן? וי"ל: דמשמע ליה, משעה שקנאה הגזלן היא של לוקח, אע"פ שלא עשה בו שום מעשה. וא"ת: מעותיו שהיו תחלה מלוה נעשו עתה מכר? וי"ל: באתרא דלא קנו בכספא. א"נ, במלוה אינו יכול לקנות, כדאמרינן פ"ק דקדושין (דף ו:): "המקדש במלוה אינה מקודשת", ובמכר לא קנה. והא דאמר בהאיש מקדש (שם דף מז.): "ושוין שבמכר קנה", היינו במלוה שיש לו על אחרים; דאז באשה בענין זה מקודשת לכ"ע, אי לאו דאשה לא סמכא דעתה ויראה שיחזור וימחול. אבל מלוה שאשה חייבת לו, אם מוחל לה ומקדשה בה אינה מקודשת, דלא נתן לה כלום, דמקמי הכי היה ברשותה; וכן במכר לא קנה. אע"ג דכשמקדשה בהנאת מחילת מלוה היא מקודשת, דלא גרע מ"ארווח לה זמנא" ו"אדבר עליך לשלטון" דמקודשת, וכן במכר אם מכר בהנאת מחילה קונה כמו ב"החליף דמי שור בפרה" — מ"מ לא משמע ליה שהיה מקנה לו בהנאת מחילת מלוה, משום דמשמע מיד שלקחה הגזלן קנה לוקח ראשון:
Tosafot on Bava Metzia 16a:13:1.english: "This document is merely a shard" - And if you ask: Let [the Gemara] say that [the buyer] acquires it by taking possession of it after the robber acquired it? And one can answer: It seems to [Rami bar Ḥama] that from the moment the robber acquired it, it belongs to the buyer, even though he did not perform any act [of acquisition] with it. And if you ask: His money, which was initially a loan, has now become [purchase money for] a sale? And one can answer: [We are dealing] in a place where they do not acquire [land] with money [alone]. Alternatively, one cannot acquire with a loan, as we say in the first chapter of Kiddushin (6b): "One who betroths [a woman] with a loan, she is not betrothed," and in a sale, he has not acquired [it]. And that which [the Gemara] says in [the chapter] HaIsh Mekadesh (ibid. 47a): "And they agree that in a sale he has acquired [it]," that refers to a loan that [the seller] holds against others; for then, in the case of a woman, in this manner she would be betrothed according to all opinions, were it not that a woman does not rely upon it and fears that he will retract and forgive [the debt]. However, [regarding] a loan that the woman herself owes him, if he forgives it for her and betroths her with it, she is not betrothed, because he has not given her anything, since before this it was already in her possession; and similarly in a sale, he has not acquired [the item]. Even though when he betroths her with the benefit of forgiving a loan she is betrothed — for it is no less than "I will extend your time [for payment]" or "I will speak on your behalf to the ruler," where she is betrothed, and similarly in a sale, if one sells [something] for the benefit of forgiving [a loan], [the buyer] acquires [it], just like when one "exchanged the value of an ox for a cow" — nevertheless, it did not seem to [Rami bar Ḥama] that [the robber] was transferring it to him for the benefit of forgiving a loan, because it is implied that immediately when the robber took it, the first buyer acquired [it].

Tosafot on Bava Metzia 16a:14:1.hebrew: בההיא הנאה דקא סמיך כו' - והויא כאילו א"ל: "שדה זו תהא קנויה לך לכשאקחנה":
Tosafot on Bava Metzia 16a:14:1.english: By that satisfaction that he relied [on him], etc. - And it is as if he said to him: "This field shall be acquired by you when I purchase it."

Tosafot on Bava Metzia 16a:15:1.hebrew: מה שאירש מאבא מכור לך לא אמר כלום - וא"ת: לימא דרב דאמר כר"מ, וברייתא כרבנן? וי"ל: דלדידן קפריך, דאית לן כרב — כדאיתא פרק איזהו נשך (לקמן בבא מציעא דף עב:), דמייתי גמרא טעמא דלא ליקריה גזלנא וניחא ליה דליקו בהימנותיה — וסבירא לן כרבנן דאין אדם מקנה דבר שלא בא לעולם, דשמואל פסיק כרבי יוחנן הסנדלר פרק אע"פ (כתובות דף נט(א,ב).), ורב נחמן סבר בפירות דקל אף משבאו לעולם יכול לחזור בו. ורב האי פסק דאין הלכה כרב בהא, משום דס"ל דאין אדם מקנה דבר שלא בא לעולם וכו'; ולא נהירא, מכח דאיזהו נשך (לקמן בבא מציעא דף עב:):
Tosafot on Bava Metzia 16a:15:1.english: "That which I will inherit from my father is sold to you, he has said nothing" - And if you will say: Let us say that Rav holds like R. Meir, and the baraita is like the Rabbis? And one can answer: He is asking according to our [halakhic] view, for we hold like Rav — as is stated in the chapter [entitled] Eizehu Neshekh (below, Bava Metzia 72b), where the Gemara brings the reason that he should not be called a robber and it is pleasing to him to stand by his word — and [yet] we hold like the Rabbis that a person cannot transfer something that has not yet come into the world, for Shmuel rules like R. Yochanan HaSandlar in the chapter [entitled] Af Al Pi (Ketubot 59a-b), and Rav Nachman holds regarding the fruits of a palm tree [that] even after they have come into the world one can retract. And Rav Hai [Gaon] ruled that the halakha is not like Rav in this [matter], because he holds that a person cannot transfer something that has not yet come into the world, etc.; but this does not seem right, on the basis of [the passage in] Eizehu Neshekh (below, Bava Metzia 72b).

Tosafot on Bava Metzia 16a:5:1.hebrew: מאי גזלינא מינך - וא"ת: וכי מכרה נמי, מה גזלו? והלא צריך להחזיר לו מעותיו! וי"ל, דמ"מ יקראנו גזלנא כל זמן שלא יפרע לו:
Tosafot on Bava Metzia 16a:5:1.english: What did I rob from you? - And if you ask: Even when he sold it [to him], what did he rob him of? After all, he must return his money to him! And one can answer that in any event, he will call him a robber as long as he has not paid him back.
